_status.summary: Checked the next six weeks against current sources (Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, tree, SantaCon, Harlem Holiday Lights) and added the holiday season: the tree's arrival, Saks, Bergdorf and Macy's windows, the Union Square, Columbus Circle and Grand Central markets, Bryant Park's tree, both Hanukkah menorahs, the Park Avenue and Washington Square trees, the Nostalgia Train, Hudson Yards, the Sixth Avenue ornaments, Lightscape, the Bronx Zoo lights and New Year's Eve. Entries marked approx follow last year's pattern.

bergdorf-windows.map: Bergdorf Goodman, 754 5th Ave, New York, NY
bergdorf-windows.name: Bergdorf Goodman holiday windows
bergdorf-windows.spot: After dark from the kerb, so the window and the people looking into it are both in the frame. Late evening, after 9, the crowd thins.
bergdorf-windows.time: On view at all hours once unveiled (Thu Nov 20 at 6 pm in 2025); the 2026 unveiling is not yet announced
bergdorf-windows.where: Bergdorf Goodman, Fifth Av at 57 St to 58 St
bergdorf-windows.why: Hand-built tableaux, the most elaborate windows on Fifth Avenue; after dark the reflections of passers-by lie over the scenes.

bronx-zoo-lights.spot: Arrive at 4:30 pm for blue hour on the trails before the crowd builds.
bronx-zoo-lights.time: Tickets from 1 pm; the lantern trails open at 4:30 pm
bronx-zoo-lights.where: Bronx Zoo, Bronx River or Southern Blvd gates
bronx-zoo-lights.why: Giant animal lanterns along wooded paths.

bryant-park-tree.spot: The terrace on the library side looks down over the rink to the tree. Come for blue hour, a little after 4:30 pm.
bryant-park-tree.why: The Winter Village tree switched on over the rink, with skaters and the lit towers of Midtown round it.

bryant-park-winter-village.map: Bryant Park Upper Terrace, behind the New York Public Library, New York, NY
bryant-park-winter-village.name: Bryant Park Winter Village holiday shops
bryant-park-winter-village.spot: The raised terrace on the library side looks down on the whole rink. Come on a weekday just after dark, when the stalls glow and the crowd is thinner.
bryant-park-winter-village.time: Holiday shops open daily through January 3; rink 8 am to 10 pm
bryant-park-winter-village.where: Bryant Park, 40 St to 42 St between Fifth and Sixth Av
bryant-park-winter-village.why: The rink and glass market stalls put skaters, shoppers and office workers in one small lit space surrounded by towers.

columbus-circle-market.map: Columbus Circle Holiday Market, New York, NY
columbus-circle-market.name: Columbus Circle Holiday Market
columbus-circle-market.spot: From the circle itself at blue hour, looking back at the curve of lit stalls and the park.
columbus-circle-market.time: 11 am to 7 pm, to 8 pm Fridays and Saturdays, closed Christmas Day (2025 hours)
columbus-circle-market.where: Columbus Circle, at the park entrance
columbus-circle-market.why: Stalls curving along the park wall, with the Maine Monument and the towers of Columbus Circle lit behind.

grand-central-fair.map: Vanderbilt Hall, Grand Central Terminal, New York, NY
grand-central-fair.name: Grand Central Holiday Fair
grand-central-fair.spot: The hall's entrance from 42nd Street looks down the aisle under the chandeliers; then step into the Main Concourse for the commuters.
grand-central-fair.time: Mon to Sat 10 am to 7 pm, Sun 11 am to 6 pm; Dec 17 to 23, 10 am to 8 pm; Dec 24 to 6 pm; closed Thanksgiving Day
grand-central-fair.why: Indoors, under the chandeliers of Vanderbilt Hall, next to the Main Concourse: the wet-day option.

harlem-holiday-lights.map: W 125th St & Adam Clayton Powell Jr Blvd, New York, NY
harlem-holiday-lights.name: Harlem Holiday Lights
harlem-holiday-lights.spot: Stand at 125 St and Adam Clayton Powell Jr Blvd near the Apollo. The start time is not yet published, so check closer to the date.
harlem-holiday-lights.time: About 6 pm (the 2025 start time; the 2026 time is not yet published)
harlem-holiday-lights.why: A parade of more than 20 lit floats along 125th Street, the city's only parade of lights, with the season's lights switched on along the street.

hudson-yards-lights.map: Vessel, Hudson Yards, New York, NY
hudson-yards-lights.name: Vessel holiday lighting, Hudson Yards
hudson-yards-lights.spot: From the edge of the plaza by the High Line stairs, so the whole Vessel and the people under it fit the frame.
hudson-yards-lights.time: Lighting ceremony Mon Nov 16 from 6 pm; then a light show on the Vessel's outside every evening to Jan 7. Free outside; climbing the Vessel is ticketed
hudson-yards-lights.where: Hudson Yards Public Square, 33 St at Tenth Av
hudson-yards-lights.why: The Vessel's honeycomb lit against the glass towers, and lit tunnels across the plaza: strong geometry for night street work.

icp-cameras-and-coffee-november.map: International Center of Photography, 84 Ludlow St, New York, NY
icp-cameras-and-coffee-november.name: Cameras and Coffee: Sony sensor cleaning meet-up at ICP
icp-cameras-and-coffee-november.spot: RSVP on the ICP page. The sensor cleaning is run with Sony, so check with K&M before bringing a Leica. Gallery entry is a separate ticket.
icp-cameras-and-coffee-november.time: 11 am to 1 pm; free with RSVP. Sensor cleaning drop-off at K&M, 54 Orchard St, 10:15 to 11 am
icp-cameras-and-coffee-november.where: ICP Cafe, 84 Ludlow St, Lower East Side
icp-cameras-and-coffee-november.why: A monthly meet-up for photographers and camera owners with ICP faculty and Sony's Tony Gale, plus a sensor cleaning drop-off at K&M around the corner.

icp-gerald-cyrus-uptown-odyssey.map: International Center of Photography, 84 Ludlow St, New York, NY
icp-gerald-cyrus-uptown-odyssey.name: Gerald Cyrus: Uptown Odyssey book event at ICP
icp-gerald-cyrus-uptown-odyssey.spot: Book through the Get Tickets link on the ICP page; seats are limited and the $5 ticket does not include the galleries.
icp-gerald-cyrus-uptown-odyssey.time: 6:30 pm to 8 pm; $5 in person (no gallery access), also online
icp-gerald-cyrus-uptown-odyssey.where: ICP Library, 84 Ludlow St, Lower East Side
icp-gerald-cyrus-uptown-odyssey.why: Gerald Cyrus talks with Gioncarlo Valentine about his book of 1990s black-and-white Harlem photographs: street scenes, families, storefronts, the subway and jazz clubs.

lightscape-bbg.map: Brooklyn Botanic Garden, 990 Washington Ave, Brooklyn, NY
lightscape-bbg.name: Lightscape at Brooklyn Botanic Garden
lightscape-bbg.spot: Book the first entry slot of the evening for room on the paths.
lightscape-bbg.time: Select evenings, ticketed with timed entry
lightscape-bbg.why: A walk-through trail of light installations in the trees and over the water.

macys-windows.map: Macy's Herald Square, 151 W 34th St, New York, NY
macys-windows.name: Macy's Herald Square holiday windows
macys-windows.spot: The Broadway side, after dark. Stand back from the glass so the window and the faces lit by it share the frame.
macys-windows.time: From the unveiling (Thu Nov 20 in 2025, viewing from 4 pm); the 2026 date is not yet announced
macys-windows.where: Macy's, Broadway at 34 St to 35 St
macys-windows.why: Animated windows playing in sequence along Broadway, with Herald Square's crowds and yellow cabs reflected in the glass. In the parade's 100th year Macy's has promised special windows.

menorah-brooklyn.name: Hanukkah menorah lighting, Grand Army Plaza, Brooklyn
menorah-brooklyn.spot: Stand on the park side so the arch is behind the menorah. The first night, Friday Dec 4, is the busiest.
menorah-brooklyn.time: Nightly through Hanukkah, Dec 4 to 11. In 2024: weeknights 6 pm, Friday about 3:30 pm, Saturday about 7:15 pm, Sunday 5 pm, with a concert from 4 pm on the first night; 2026 times are not yet published
menorah-brooklyn.where: Grand Army Plaza, Brooklyn, by the arch
menorah-brooklyn.why: The menorah with the floodlit Soldiers' and Sailors' Arch behind; the first night has a crowd and live music.

menorah-manhattan.map: Grand Army Plaza, 5th Ave & E 59th St, New York, NY
menorah-manhattan.name: Hanukkah menorah lighting, Fifth Av at 59 St
menorah-manhattan.spot: From the park side of Fifth Avenue so the Plaza Hotel stands behind the menorah. The Friday lightings are early, before sunset, in daylight.
menorah-manhattan.time: Nightly through Hanukkah, Dec 4 to 11. In 2025: 5:30 pm Sunday to Thursday, about 3:45 pm Friday, 8:30 pm Saturday; the 2026 times are not yet published
menorah-manhattan.where: Grand Army Plaza, Fifth Av at 59 St, across from the Plaza Hotel
menorah-manhattan.why: A 36-foot steel menorah, lit by a rabbi raised in a crane basket, against the Plaza Hotel and the edge of the park.

nostalgia-train.map: 2 Av Station, E Houston St, New York, NY
nostalgia-train.name: Holiday Nostalgia Train
nostalgia-train.spot: Board at the start, 2 Av–Houston, for room to move; ride the whole way and shoot the platforms as the old train pulls in among today's riders.
nostalgia-train.time: Sundays in December, about 10 am to 5 pm (2025): uptown from 2 Av–Houston St at 10 am, noon, 2 and 4 pm; downtown from 96 St–2 Av at 11 am, 1, 3 and 5 pm. The 2026 schedule is not yet announced
nostalgia-train.where: The F and Q lines, 2 Av–Houston St to 96 St–2 Av
nostalgia-train.why: 1930s subway cars with rattan seats, ceiling fans and old adverts; riders often come dressed for the period.

nye.name: New Year's Eve in Times Square
nye.time: 2025 pattern: pens open about 3 pm, the ball rises at 6 pm, descends at 11:59 pm; Broadway and Seventh Av close to traffic from about 11 am
nye.where: Times Square; entry from Sixth or Eighth Av at checkpoints

nye-central-park.name: Midnight Run and fireworks, Central Park
nye-central-park.spot: Along the Lake near Bow Bridge or at Cherry Hill. Be in place by 11:30 pm with the camera braced.
nye-central-park.time: Fireworks at midnight start the four-mile NYRR Midnight Run; the start area is not yet published
nye-central-park.where: Central Park; in 2025 the fireworks rose between Bow Bridge and Cherry Hill
nye-central-park.why: Costumed runners setting off under fireworks over the Lake: a crowd lit by the bursts.

nye-prospect-park.name: New Year's Eve fireworks, Prospect Park
nye-prospect-park.spot: Grand Army Plaza by the arch, or the Long Meadow's north end for open sky.
nye-prospect-park.time: Music from 10 pm, fireworks at midnight, weather permitting (2025)
nye-prospect-park.where: Grand Army Plaza and the north end of the Long Meadow, Prospect Park
nye-prospect-park.why: Fireworks over the park with the Soldiers' and Sailors' Arch nearby, and a smaller, friendlier crowd than Manhattan.

ideas.title: Carols on the steps

park-avenue-trees.map: Brick Presbyterian Church, 1140 Park Ave, New York, NY
park-avenue-trees.name: Park Avenue tree lighting
park-avenue-trees.spot: Stand on a median island in the 80s and shoot south down the line of trees toward the MetLife Building at blue hour; wait for the lights to change.
park-avenue-trees.time: Sun Dec 6, 6:30 to 7:30 pm: carols on the church steps, then the trees light; they stay lit through the season
park-avenue-trees.where: Brick Presbyterian Church, Park Av at 91 St; the trees run down the Park Avenue malls from 54 St to 97 St
park-avenue-trees.why: A mile and a half of white-lit firs down the middle of Park Avenue, the MetLife Building closing the view.

playback-street-party.map: BAM Rose Cinemas, 30 Lafayette Ave, Brooklyn, NY
playback-street-party.name: Playback Street Party at BAM
playback-street-party.spot: Start on the Lafayette Av pavement facing the BAM facade around midday when the crowd is thickest; the Williamsburgh Savings Bank tower gives a backdrop to the west.
playback-street-party.time: 11 am to 5 pm, free (RSVP on the BAM page)
playback-street-party.where: Outside BAM Rose Cinemas, Lafayette Av, Fort Greene
playback-street-party.why: An all-day free street party for Spike Lee's Playback film festival, with local Brooklyn artists, musicians and neighbours outside BAM.

saks-light-show.map: Saks Fifth Avenue, 611 5th Ave, New York, NY
saks-light-show.name: Saks Fifth Avenue windows and light show
saks-light-show.spot: Cross to the Channel Gardens side of Fifth Avenue and shoot back across the traffic: the lit facade fills the frame and the crowd is lit from the front.
saks-light-show.time: Unveiled Mon Nov 23. The facade show ran every 10 minutes, 5 to 11 pm, in 2025; 2026 show times are not yet out
saks-light-show.where: Saks, Fifth Av at 49 St to 50 St, facing the Channel Gardens
saks-light-show.why: The whole facade pulses with light to music, and the crowd on Fifth Avenue is lit by it every ten minutes.

santacon.time: 9 am to 9 pm; the start point is announced the week before (39 St and Broadway in 2025)

seaport-diwali.map: South Street Seaport Museum, 213 Water St, New York, NY
seaport-diwali.name: Diwali at the Seaport Museum
seaport-diwali.spot: Arrive at 4 pm while the large petal rangoli is being laid out; stay for the 5 pm dance as the light goes and the shop windows light up.
seaport-diwali.time: 4 pm to 6 pm, free; preregistration encouraged
seaport-diwali.where: Cobblestones outside 213 Water St, South Street Seaport
seaport-diwali.why: Rangoli in sand and flower petals, henna and a dance performance on the Water Street cobblestones beside 19th-century buildings.

sixth-ave-ornaments.map: 1251 Avenue of the Americas, New York, NY
sixth-ave-ornaments.name: Giant ornaments on Sixth Avenue
sixth-ave-ornaments.spot: Get low by the pool's edge for reflections, with the neon of Radio City behind.
sixth-ave-ornaments.time: Up day and night through the season; the 2026 install date is not published
sixth-ave-ornaments.where: Sixth Av at 49 St to 50 St, opposite Radio City Music Hall
sixth-ave-ornaments.why: Oversized red baubles in the fountain pool, with Radio City's neon across the avenue.

thanksgiving.time: 8:30 am to about noon (the 100th parade; Macy's has confirmed the 8:30 am start, not yet the 2026 route map)
thanksgiving.where: Central Park West from 77 St, Central Park South to Sixth Av, then Sixth Av to 34 St

tree.time: About 7 to 10 pm; the tree is lit near the end (2025 pattern; the 2026 time is not yet announced)

ideas.text: The tree hanging from the crane, with the crew's hands on the guide ropes.
ideas.title: The lift

ideas.text: The bare tree towering over the rink and the gold Prometheus, the crowd small below.
ideas.title: Before the lights

tree-arrival.name: The Rockefeller Center tree arrives
tree-arrival.spot: From the top of the Channel Gardens on Fifth Avenue you see the crane, the tree and Prometheus in one frame. Come early; the lift is in the morning.
tree-arrival.time: Morning: the tree is craned into the plaza (Meet the Tree Day)
tree-arrival.why: A 70-odd-foot spruce swung into place by crane, wrapped and unlit, with crews in hard hats and a crowd of early risers.

ideas.text: Frame a vendor lit only by the lamps of the stall, with the dark park behind.

union-square-holiday-market.map: Union Square South Plaza, E 14th St & Broadway, New York, NY
union-square-holiday-market.name: Union Square Holiday Market
union-square-holiday-market.spot: Work the alleys between stalls just after dark on a weekday, when the stall lights are on and the after-work crowd is out; the subway exits on 14 St give a steady stream of people.
union-square-holiday-market.where: South end of Union Square Park, by E 14 St
union-square-holiday-market.why: Rows of red-and-white stalls fill the south end of the park, with commuters from the subway exits cutting through shoppers and vendors.

veterans.time: March 12:30 pm to about 3:30 pm, rain or shine. The wreath-laying at Madison Square Park comes first, about 11 am (the 2026 time is not yet published)
veterans.where: Fifth Av, 26 St to about 50 St

ideas.text: The tree framed by the Arch, Fifth Avenue's lights behind.
ideas.title: The tree in the Arch

ideas.text: A brass player's breath and the lit tree behind.
ideas.title: The quartet

ideas.text: A lone figure under the Arch late in the evening.
ideas.title: After the crowd

washington-square-tree.map: Washington Square Arch, New York, NY
washington-square-tree.name: Washington Square tree lighting
washington-square-tree.spot: From the fountain, looking north, so the tree sits inside the Arch with Fifth Avenue beyond.
washington-square-tree.time: 6 pm on the lighting night (Thu Dec 11 in 2025; the 2026 date is usually the first or second week of December); then lit 4 pm to 1 am nightly
washington-square-tree.where: Washington Square Park, under the Arch
washington-square-tree.why: The tree framed inside the Arch with carollers and a brass quartet: one of the city's classic holiday frames.
